meta.description: Compare 11 AI chains for spoken Kinyarwanda by answer quality, response time, cost, hosting and environmental impact.
meta.og_description: Independent results for 11 AI chains tested on 24 spoken Kinyarwanda questions.

hero.lead_html: Two years ago the best AI model scored 41 out of 100 on spoken Kinyarwanda questions. Today the best of 11 AI chains scores 92. More than 10 million people speak Kinyarwanda, and for many of them a WhatsApp voice note is the easiest way to ask for help.

voice.text:
Muraho! Umwana wanjye
afite umuriro. Nkore iki?
voice.sub:
Hello! My child has a fever.
What should I do?

board.hint: Blue columns can run in your own country. The dashed line is the 10 s limit for phone calls.
board.note: Sovereign-deployable: every step can run in your country or on your own servers, using open-weight models or, for Intron, speech recognition on local hardware. Private API: at least one step is only available from its maker’s cloud. Cost is the observed whole-workflow Gooey.AI charge across the 24 benchmark runs; all chains were charged the same rounded $0.04 per run. Hosting types are sample values until confirmed. CO₂e uses EcoCost estimates from the benchmark runs and covers text-model inference only, excluding speech recognition and direct-audio inference. Intron’s offline option still needs confirming for Kinyarwanda.

scatter.aria: DeepSeek V4 with Omnilingual has the highest score.

score.front: Labelled best trade-offs: none is faster and more accurate
score.note: Hover a point for a quick look, select it for details. Source: Gooey.AI and CLEAR Global, Aug 30, 2026.

cost.front: All chains had the same observed rounded charge
cost.note: Arithmetic mean of 24 observed whole-workflow Gooey.AI charges per chain, normalized to 1,000 questions. Historical benchmark pricing, not a future-price guarantee. Source: public Gooey.AI run records, Aug 30, 2026.

carbon.front: Labelled best trade-offs among covered chains
carbon.note: EcoCost estimate from 24 runs per covered chain; low confidence. Speech recognition and direct-audio inference are excluded. Source: Gooey.AI run records, Aug 30, 2026.

chains_foot_p:
Answer score: match with an expert’s answer, 0 to 100, over 24 questions. Response: median seconds.
Sovereign chains can run in your country; private ones need a maker’s cloud API.
samples_intro: Three of the 24 questions, sent as WhatsApp voice notes. Answers are from GPT-5.6 Sol with Omnilingual, each graded against an expert’s.
